purpose: Frozen expected answers for CH05's blocked:surf derivation -- the terrain-gated half of the capability model. slice2's oracle (slice2_blocked_expectations.json) validated the EVENT-obstacle route via rock_smash; this validates the TERRAIN-obstacle route, which inverts it (a terrain obstacle flips a graph-BLOCKED cell to passable, where an event obstacle flips a graph-WALKABLE cell to blocked). CH05 carries the corpus's only terrain-gated instances, so without this file that half of the model ships unvalidated.

provenance_honesty.why: slice2's oracle was frozen before its derivation code existed. This one cannot make that claim and does not: the derivation engine (traversal/capabilities.py + traversal/reachability.py) already shipped with slice 2, and its answer for the two goal cells was spot-checked during the investigation that preceded this file. Recording that plainly, because an oracle whose independence is overstated is worse than one with none -- the reader would trust a diff that proves less than it appears to.
provenance_honesty.what_is_genuinely_independent: The PRIOR is independent, and it is what this file freezes. The sealed-room analysis was written up in PLAYTEST_AUTHORING_IMPROVEMENT_V2.md's CH05 dry run (2026-08-27..29) and reproduced in reference/chapters/05-passage-cave.md and CH05_DECISIONS.md B2, all of which predate any surf derivation being run. Those documents assert the geometry (513 walkable cells in 7 components, 450 reachable on foot from the entrance, a sealed 30-tile room at x31-36/y11-16 opening only onto terrain-tag-7 water) and the consequence (TM76 and Sableyeite need Surf). This file makes that prose machine-checkable.
provenance_honesty.what_this_still_catches: Regression and over-derivation. The negative arm below is the load-bearing half: it asserts that NO other map036 row derives surf. A derivation that flipped to marking the whole map surf-gated would satisfy the positive arm alone and fail here.

rule: Do not edit this file to make a failing derivation pass. If the derivation disagrees, investigate the derivation first. If this file is genuinely wrong, correct it in its own commit, stating what evidence overturned it -- never silently alongside the change that made it fail.

start_cells.note: Derived, not typed. Each is the destination of the single warp that enters the map, read out of the decoded corpus -- see _CHAPTER_MAP_START_CELLS in chapter_manifest/generator.py for the same citations.

sets.rationale: Map036 has 8 events / 15 page rows. Exactly two events (ev008, ev009) sit inside the sealed room at x31-36 / y11-16; the other six are in the 450-cell on-foot component reachable from (17,39). So exactly 4 rows carry surf and the remaining 11 carry none. This arm exists to catch over-derivation: marking a whole map surf-gated would pass the positive arm on its own.

Map037 has no surfable water and no capability gate of any kind; its only traversal constraint is the four diagonal staircases, which are metatile behaviour and are absorbed into terrain rows rather than being a capability. No row on map 37 may derive surf.

granting_chapter.evidence: Map143 is the ONLY map in the 199-map decoded corpus containing Kernel.pbReceiveItem(::PBItems::HM03) -- events 22 ('the event', at 27,46) and 24 ('theo event2', at 27,47). Verified by scanning all 199 decoded maps on 2026-09-01.
granting_chapter.atlas_discrepancy: reference/chapters.json's CH30 (Amatree Town) note claims it carries 'the HM03 Surf grant'. That is not supported by the corpus: CH30's maps are 151/170/171/69, none of which contains the HM03 grant. CH05's Surf revisit debt is therefore owed to a Route 10 chapter, not to Amatree Town. Flagged for the atlas maintainer; not silently rewritten here, because WHICH chapter owns a grant is a chapter-assignment call, not a build-agent one.
granting_chapter.checker_note: RULE_BLOCKED_NO_GRANTING_CHAPTER cannot enforce any of this today: no CapabilityModel implementation exists in src/ (only a Protocol in checker.py and a test fake), and reference/chapters.json has no structured grants field at all -- only free-text notes. So blocked:surf will raise capability_model_unenforced, exactly as CH04's 28 blocked:rock_smash rows do. That is the standing decision (CH05_DECISIONS C4, option 2), not a new gap.
